SP2 nonlinear hybrid simulation: models and plastic hinges

The numerical substructure and the full reference frame now use elastic members with concentrated plastic hinges at every member end. Results are for the virtual hybrid simulation (vHS) of SP2 at El Centro , time scale , 2048 Hz.

Reference structure

Numerical substructure

Lower-left column removed below the interface, DOFs. The interface carries only horizontal force fm; its rotation is released.

Plastic hinge model

Each member is an elastic beam-column with a rigid-plastic rotational hinge at each end. The hinge stays rigid until the end moment reaches the plastic moment, then rotates plastically with small linear kinematic hardening.

M = D (B x − θp)
|M − H θp| ≤ Mp
Mp = Fy Z, Fy = 345 MPa (50 ksi)
H = 0.01 × 4EI/L
  • Not modelled: hinge length, P-Delta, axial-moment interaction, local buckling, deterioration or fracture.
  • Base rotational springs stay elastic, with their calibrated stiffness.
  • Return mapping each sample: Newmark average acceleration plus an active-set solve. Up to 30 iterations; on failure the previous state and command are held.
±Mp numerical sub reference

Hysteresis of one plastic hinge, (W8x24 beam, first floor, middle bay), from the same vHS run. End rotation is the member-end rotation relative to the chord, elastic plus plastic. The sloped branches are elastic bending; the plateaus at ±Mp are plastic rotation.

Floor response, linear vs nonlinear

Click a legend entry to show or hide it. Controller-path vHS: numerical sub with phase lead, PID and actuator model, and an elastic specimen spring. The small permanent offset of the nonlinear curves after shaking is the residual drift left by the plastic rotations.

Story shear vs story drift, reference structure

Story shear from the frame restoring forces (inertia and damping excluded) against interstory drift, earthquake time 5–25 s, light to dark as time advances (same style as the force–displacement hysteresis in visualize_saved_results.m). The linear model is the same solver with the hinges disabled (Mp = ∞). Shared axes.
